payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort digits ascending; if no 0 return -1. Group by mod 3, remove smallest digit(s) to make sum divisible by 3, then output digits descending.
payload.rationale: The solution constructs the maximum number divisible by 2,3,5 by greedy removal of the smallest digits that disturb divisibility by 3, after ensuring 0 exists. Sorting and remainder grouping are key.
